title: Hook Telemetry Envelope
description: Common envelope a marketplace plugin hook (producer) emits to a consumer-set sink. Versioned by schema_version. Per-hook detail lives in `data`, described by data/<hook>.schema.json keyed on the `hook` value. Contract-doc only: no validator is wired (see README).

schema_version.description: SemVer version of this envelope contract.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant the hook finished. True UTC (TZ=UTC) — the Z suffix is not a local-time lie.

hook.description: Producer hook id, e.g. "markdown-format". NOT Claude Code's hook_name (event:matcher). Keys data-schema discovery: data/<hook>.schema.json.

hook_event.description: Free string naming the triggering event (PostToolUse, SessionStart, ConfigChange, WorktreeCreate, ...). Deliberately not an enum.

status.description: Universal execution outcome. Consumers MUST tolerate unknown future values (treat as a catch-all, never hard-fail).

duration_ms.description: This hook's own runtime in milliseconds. NOT Claude Code's aggregate total_duration_ms.

data.description: Per-hook payload; always present (at minimum {}). Shape described by data/<hook>.schema.json. Generic sinks ignore this and consume only the common fields.
